links.outcome: GPT-4o diagnostic accuracy versus radiology residents on same emergency abdominal CT cases
links.effect: Overall accuracy 76% for R1-R2, 89% for R3, 82% for R4-R5, 84% for R6, and 82% for GPT-4o; no statistically significant differences between GPT-4o and residents (p > 0.05).
links.quote: No statistically significant differences in diagnostic accuracy were found between GPT-4o and the residents, regardless of the experience level or case difficulty (p > 0.05).

links.outcome: GPT-4o hallucination rate in CT image interpretation
links.effect: GPT-4o demonstrated a hallucination rate of 75%.
links.quote: GPT-4o demonstrated a hallucination rate of 75%.

screen.reason: The study directly compares the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4o against radiology residents on 45 emergency abdominal CT cases, and tracks hallucination rates, but does not evaluate a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
